sections: 7.5 file structure, xref active/free state and generations

decisions: Never invoke recovery during normal parsing or swallow a latched failure
Require recoverable active/free identities or a complete explicit caller inventory; do not resurrect bodies from source position
Require exact declared/caller stream extents; never scan payload markers
Keep the exact source and record every selected/excluded/discarded object and structural decision
Stage a full rewrite and apply ordinary strict syntax post-validation before copying output
limitations: Independent small fixtures are not a complete damaged/ambiguous corpus or production qualification
